meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes, Hale. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first, so start with who decided that.
You asked for this meeting, so I'm waiting. Was Owen heard before that zero went in, or not?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, an apology for entering it before anyone spoke to Owen or called me, and confirmation that nothing is on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She ended at her opening position, agreed to nothing, and still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing placed on his record; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached because the meeting ended after your first line.
What moved her: Nothing, because she heard no ownership and saw no evidence.
What cost ground: Nothing lost ground outright, but thanking her without answering her question about who decided left her opening demand standing.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she opens by asking who decided, own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called home, then show her a dated document tied to Owen's own work that she can check herself.
